what: In-subspace orthogonal null for the L8 project_out family, and the layer-matched knife/bomb comparison.
why: E12 claimed cos(knife,bomb)=0.6117 predicts an effect ratio 0.50, i.e. the shared component is the causally active part. Both inputs to that claim are wrong: the ratio was cross-layer, and a cos=0 direction reaches the knife effect exactly.
layer_matched_effect_ratio_flips: 9/21 = 0.4286 (published 0.50 was knife L8 over bomb L12)
verdict: knife z=1.34 does not clear the hard in-subspace null; bomb L8 z=3.23 does. The cosine-to-effect-ratio inference is not identified: at cos=0 the observed effect spans -0.0121..+0.0182.
